name: Halle (Saale)
queryAndRequestSummary: Separate English and German first-party discovery identified Halle's official Liegenschaftskarte procedure and the state LVermGeo ALKIS open-data WFS. Capabilities and a bounded anonymous WFS response were inspected. The exact WUP-point bbox returned zero; a correctly projected nearby bbox returned three polygons.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: official Halle procedure page; directs users to Geobasis-Viewer and describes parcel boundaries
official state ALKIS service documentation; WMS/WFS scope and no-personal-data distinction
HTTP 200; native layer ave:Flurstueck, WFS 2.0 capabilities and schema exposed
HTTP 200; zero returned for exact-point bbox only
HTTP 200; three complete GML parcel polygons with stable native IDs

scopeLimits: The sample is limited to three parcels from one bounded response and does not establish citywide completeness.
The exact-point zero result is not evidence of absence; the WUP coordinate was preserved and not shifted.
Halle's local page establishes the local public procedure, while LVermGeo is the state geometry custodian.
Only safe identity, geometry, CRS, and service metadata were requested/retained; raw native attributes remain in ignored temporary evidence only.

nativeFieldMapping.compositeKeyProvenance: The source also returned flstkennz and component fields, but these were not retained in GeoJSON; idflurst was selected as the stable native parcel identity.

uncertainty: Public state WFS access and three safe polygons are verified, but adapter qualification and citywide coverage remain for serial review. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS exception, or unsafe fields were used.
